import ctypes
import numpy as np

# Load the libraries
ctypes.CDLL('/usr/local/gsl/lib/libgslcblas.so', mode=ctypes.RTLD_GLOBAL)
gsl = ctypes.CDLL('/usr/local/gsl/lib/libgsl.so')

# Define the function
def lq_decomposition(matrix, tau):
    # Convert input lists to numpy arrays
    matrix_np = np.array(matrix, dtype=np.double)

    # Ensure tau has the correct size
    tau_size = min(matrix_np.shape)
    tau_np = np.zeros(tau_size, dtype=np.double)

    # Create GSL matrix and vector
    gsl_matrix_alloc = gsl.gsl_matrix_alloc
    gsl_matrix_alloc.restype = ctypes.POINTER(ctypes.c_double)
    gsl_matrix_alloc.argtypes = [ctypes.c_size_t, ctypes.c_size_t]
    gsl_matrix = gsl_matrix_alloc(matrix_np.shape[0], matrix_np.shape[1])

    gsl_vector_alloc = gsl.gsl_vector_alloc
    gsl_vector_alloc.restype = ctypes.POINTER(ctypes.c_double)
    gsl_vector_alloc.argtypes = [ctypes.c_size_t]
    gsl_vector = gsl_vector_alloc(tau_size)

    # Copy data to GSL structures
    gsl_matrix_set = gsl.gsl_matrix_set
    gsl_matrix_set.argtypes = [ctypes.POINTER(ctypes.c_double), ctypes.c_size_t, ctypes.c_size_t, ctypes.c_double]

    for i in range(matrix_np.shape[0]):
        for j in range(matrix_np.shape[1]):
            gsl_matrix_set(gsl_matrix, i, j, matrix_np[i, j])

    # Define the argument types for the GSL function
    gsl.gsl_linalg_LQ_decomp.argtypes = [ctypes.POINTER(ctypes.c_double), ctypes.POINTER(ctypes.c_double)]
    gsl.gsl_linalg_LQ_decomp.restype = ctypes.c_int

    # Call the GSL function
    result = gsl.gsl_linalg_LQ_decomp(gsl_matrix, gsl_vector)

    # Check for success
    if result != 0:
        raise RuntimeError('LQ decomposition failed')

    # Extract results
    decomposed_matrix = np.zeros_like(matrix_np)
    gsl_matrix_get = gsl.gsl_matrix_get
    gsl_matrix_get.argtypes = [ctypes.POINTER(ctypes.c_double), ctypes.c_size_t, ctypes.c_size_t]
    gsl_matrix_get.restype = ctypes.c_double

    for i in range(matrix_np.shape[0]):
        for j in range(matrix_np.shape[1]):
            decomposed_matrix[i, j] = gsl_matrix_get(gsl_matrix, i, j)

    tau_result = np.zeros(tau_size, dtype=np.double)
    gsl_vector_get = gsl.gsl_vector_get
    gsl_vector_get.argtypes = [ctypes.POINTER(ctypes.c_double), ctypes.c_size_t]
    gsl_vector_get.restype = ctypes.c_double

    for i in range(tau_size):
        tau_result[i] = gsl_vector_get(gsl_vector, i)

    # Free GSL structures
    gsl.gsl_matrix_free(gsl_matrix)
    gsl.gsl_vector_free(gsl_vector)

    return decomposed_matrix, tau_result

# Assertion tests
def assert_test():
    # Test case 1
    matrix = [[1.0, 2.0], [3.0, 4.0]]
    decomposed_matrix, tau_result = lq_decomposition(matrix, [])
    assert decomposed_matrix.shape == (2, 2)
    assert tau_result.shape == (2,)

    # Test case 2
    matrix = [[5.0, 6.0, 7.0], [8.0, 9.0, 10.0]]
    decomposed_matrix, tau_result = lq_decomposition(matrix, [])
    assert decomposed_matrix.shape == (2, 3)
    assert tau_result.shape == (2,)

    # Test case 3
    matrix = [[11.0, 12.0], [13.0, 14.0], [15.0, 16.0]]
    decomposed_matrix, tau_result = lq_decomposition(matrix, [])
    assert decomposed_matrix.shape == (3, 2)
    assert tau_result.shape == (2,)

if __name__ == '__main__':
    assert_test()
